pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft emotional piano intro, quiet reflective atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
Every time you smiled
something inside me trembled
like a fragile glass
holding too much light

We both knew the truth
but stayed quiet
pretending the cracks
would disappear with time

When I held your hand
I was afraid
you might fall
the way I did

[Chorus]
If we could dream together
maybe things were different
but the road stops here

We loved each other
but our hands
could never quite reach

So tonight
we loosen our fingers slowly
and let the silence breathe

[Verse 2]
I was the one
who kept holding on
whenever you tried to leave

Only now I understand
the way you looked at me
carried the same quiet weight

The love I held
was also living
inside your heart

just as quietly

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, warm and reflective)

[Bridge]
Because we know each other
too well

Every step closer
brings another small wound

I cannot watch
your eyes grow dim again

so I stop
right here

[Chorus]
If we could dream together
I would stay

But love sometimes
walks beside goodbye

The moments you lived
inside my days
were gentle and real

Thank you
for every small season
we shared

[Outro]
(soft fading piano outro)

You were
my first quiet love

and the last one
that stayed

Goodbye
my love
